verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm that https://amplitude.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an agent-oriented product summary. A markdown docs endpoint (docs.md) is also live, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable documentation. An OpenAPI spec exists as well, but that belongs to a separate API-description story and is not credited here. missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt depth or coverage (e.g., llms-full.txt or per-page markdown), independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs.
